entries.source: Double-Edged Sword
entries.translation: 双刃剑
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54844

entries.source: Bosses have <color=#00E317>x0.75</color> Health<Heart> and Armor<Armor> in the first phase but <color=red>x1.25</color> in the second phase.
entries.translation: 首领第一阶段的生命<Heart>与护甲<Armor>为<color=#00E317>x0.75</color>，第二阶段则为<color=red>x1.25</color>。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54844

entries.source: Inferior Arms
entries.translation: 劣质武装
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54845

entries.source: Your starting Weapon has a Negative Enchantment.
entries.translation: 初始武器带有负面附魔。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54845

entries.source: Occult Grounds
entries.translation: 秘术之地
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54846

entries.source: Floors contain up to ((x3.00)) times more packs of Enchanted Enemies.
entries.translation: 各楼层的附魔敌人群数量最多增至 ((x3.00)) 倍。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54846

entries.source: Warming Up
entries.translation: 热身
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54847

entries.source: Stamina Recovery Speed<sprite name="Stamina"> is delayed by ((+3)) seconds on Floor 1, ((+2)) seconds on Floor 2 and ((+1)) second on Floor 3.
entries.translation: 第 1 层的耐力恢复<sprite name="Stamina">延迟 ((+3)) 秒，第 2 层延迟 ((+2)) 秒，第 3 层延迟 ((+1)) 秒。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54847

entries.source: Afterlife Express
entries.translation: 来世特快
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54848

entries.source:
Reapers can now spawn regardless of how Cursed<Curse> you are.
Reapers gain Armor<Armor> and an additional ##Attack.
entries.translation:
无论你有多少诅咒<Curse>，收割者都可能出现。
收割者获得护甲<Armor>，并多出一种##攻击。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54848

entries.source: Monster Jam
entries.translation: 怪物狂欢
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54849

entries.source: You sometimes encounter Rooms filled to the brink with Enemies.
entries.translation: 你有时会遇到挤满敌人的房间。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54849

entries.source: Remote Guardians
entries.translation: 远程守卫
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54850

entries.source: Bosses are accompanied by ((2)) random Guardian Automatons.
entries.translation: 首领会有 ((2)) 个随机守卫自动机随行。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54850

entries.source: Unjust Incentive
entries.translation: 不公的诱惑
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54851

entries.source:
Some Doors require sacrificing
((1)) Heart<sprite name="Heart"> to open them.
entries.translation:
某些门需要牺牲
((1)) 颗红心<sprite name="Heart">才能打开。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54851

entries.source: Archnemesis
entries.translation: 宿敌
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54852

entries.source:
Bosses, Mimics and Basilisks are Enchanted.
<color=grey>(Bosses don't receive any Health<sprite name=Heart> or Armor<sprite name=Armor> bonus from being enchanted.)</color>
entries.translation:
首领、宝箱怪与蛇怪都带有附魔。
<color=grey>（首领不会因附魔而额外获得生命<sprite name=Heart>或护甲<sprite name=Armor>加成。）</color>
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54852

entries.source: Calamitous Visions
entries.translation: 灾厄幻象
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54853

entries.source: New oppressive Enemy Enchantments can appear.
entries.translation: 可能出现新的强力敌人附魔。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54853

entries.source: Defensive Measures
entries.translation: 防御措施
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54854

entries.source: Enchanted Enemies have a ((20%)) chance to gain an additional Defensive Modifier.
entries.translation: 附魔敌人有 ((20%)) 几率获得额外的防御词缀。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54854

entries.source: Ebb and Flow
entries.translation: 潮起潮落
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54855

entries.source:
Floor 1 has 3 fewer rooms.
Floor 2 has 2 fewer rooms.
Floor 3 has 1 fewer room.
Floor 8 has 1 more room.
Floor 9 has 2 more rooms.
Floor 10 has 3 more rooms.
entries.translation:
第 1 层减少 3 个房间。
第 2 层减少 2 个房间。
第 3 层减少 1 个房间。
第 8 层增加 1 个房间。
第 9 层增加 2 个房间。
第 10 层增加 3 个房间。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54855

entries.source: Centurion Hunter
entries.translation: 百夫长猎手
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54856

entries.source: A Centurion Hunter Automaton will sometimes invade combat encounters and ##attack you.
entries.translation: 百夫长猎手自动机有时会闯入战斗并##攻击你。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54856

entries.source: Conquerors Will
entries.translation: 征服者意志
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54857

entries.source:
You and your Companions<Companion> deal ((x0.50)) Damage when entering Phase 1 and Phase 2 of Boss Encounters.
This penalty decays over 20 seconds, in steps of ((x0.05)).
entries.translation:
进入首领战第 1、第 2 阶段时，你与同伴<Companion>造成的伤害为 ((x0.50))。
该惩罚会在 20 秒内以 ((x0.05)) 为步长逐渐消退。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54857

entries.source: Pestilence
entries.translation: 瘟疫
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54858

entries.source:
Rooms have a chance to contain an Infested Enemy.
Infested Enemies explode on Death, spreading the Infestation to other Enemies.
entries.translation:
房间有几率出现感染敌人。
感染敌人死亡时会爆炸，将感染传播给其他敌人。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54858

entries.source: Twice Enchanted
entries.translation: 双重附魔
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54859

entries.source: Enchanted Enemies have a ((50%)) chance to gain an additional Secondary Modifier.
entries.translation: 附魔敌人有 ((50%)) 几率获得额外的次级词缀。
entries.note: 原版英文独立翻译；Cinder_System.CinderModifier / resources.assets / 54859
